headword: {急速充電|きゅうそくじゅうでん}
reading: きゅうそくじゅうでん

definitions.explanation: A method of charging batteries at a much faster rate than standard charging. Commonly discussed in relation to smartphones, electric vehicles, and portable electronics.

examples.japanese: {急速充電|きゅうそくじゅうでん}に{対応|たいおう}している。
このケーブルなら{急速充電|きゅうそくじゅうでん}ができる。
examples.english: You can fast-charge with this cable.

examples.japanese: {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}の{急速充電|きゅうそくじゅうでん}スタンドが{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}のサービスエリアに{設置|せっち}された。
examples.english: A rapid charging station for electric vehicles was installed at the highway service area.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with する. Frequently seen in product specifications, advertisements, and discussions about electric vehicles and smartphones.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急速充電|きゅうそくじゅうでん}に{対応|たいおう}する (to support rapid charging)
- {急速充電|きゅうそくじゅうでん}スタンド (rapid charging station)
- {急速充電|きゅうそくじゅうでん}{器|き} (rapid charger)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {充電|じゅうでん}: charging — the general term for charging a battery
- {満充電|まんじゅうでん}: full charge — when a battery is completely charged
